notes: ground_station lat/lon are FALLBACK Spaceport America placeholders, used only when the node has no internet at boot: with internet it geolocates itself and overrides them in memory (auto_locate:false disables that, an /admin edit outranks it). Still worth setting to the actual pad, since IP geolocation is city-level at best. callsign mirrors TeleGPS direwolf.conf MYCALL.
